Core is going to be huge. Planks, Tuck ups, Crunches, etc all are going to help strengthen your ability to maintain proper posture.

The other big thing I see with training women is that they don't do a lot of trap/rear delt exercises. Get yourself a resistance band and do Rows, Reverse Flys, High Rows etc. Strengthening the upper back will pull your shoulders back and help to adjust for the rounding of the shoulders that tends to happen with a larger chested woman.

Assuming you're not already at a BMI of perhaps 22 or lower (I say 22 because for a lot of people, 23-25 is still a bit fat), then weight loss might be helpful.

I had an issue with my chest muscles caused by underdeveloped traps and shoulders, I'm male tho so I'm not 100% sure that the same exercises that helped me will help you as much.

Exercises that help me develop my weaker back and shoulder muscles related to my chest are: lateral pulldowns, seated low row ( close grip), lateral raises, seated military press, standing shoulder press ( barbell). Any core exercises and lower back exercises will surely help you get a better posture.

Do you do any computer related work/ hobby? Sitting in that cramped position too long will also cause tightness in your back, chest and shoulders as those muscles are all closely connected. If you are in such a position a lot then set a timer every 30-45 mins and then walk around a bit and do some stetches / dynamic stretching.
